evidence: Touches src/dbwrapper.cpp, src/validation.cpp, and src/txdb.cpp under the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label to manage chainstate LevelDB compaction.
rationale: Prevents background chainstate compaction from filling the disk and causing node crashes or hangs on shutdown. Issue #36585 reported that background compaction introduced in v32.0rc3 caused disk exhaustion and hang on shutdown, making this an urgent reliability and crash-safety fix.
